Q. 1 غَرْقَلَتِ البَيْضَةُ The egg became rotten; (S, O;) the interior of the egg became corrupt: and thus غَرْقَلَ signifies said of the بِطِّيخ [i. e. melon, or water-melon]: (K:) or, said of the بطّيخ, it became hard. (O.) ＝
-A2- And غَرْقَلَ He poured water upon his head at once; (IAar, O, K, TA;) inf. n. غَرْقَلَةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
